theme: Self-worth, academic pressure, writing and social support
summary_text: The seeker felt overwhelmed and described a recent therapy conversation about tying self-worth to academic and creative success; recognizing this brought relief as well as anxiety about changing it. University workload still felt heavy, with a continuing sense of not doing enough. They had joined a writing workshop and reported that it helped, while impostor feelings still recurred. They said knowing they were not alone helped and separately described an online community as supportive, reminding them that struggle and gradual growth were acceptable. The supporter mainly validated these difficulties and offered encouragement; the seeker appreciated being listened to and intended to take things one step at a time and catch up again.
